title: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to… (CVE-2026-96198)
description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the Chromium-based Microsoft Edge browser. This flaw allows an unauthorized attacker to execute arbitrary code remotely over a network. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.8, indicating a critical impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability. No specific affected versions or patch information are provided.
